summary: Pre-alpha: resident instance with IPC v1, optional tray icon, F1 region selection overlay with Enter to pin, F3 image paste and CLI-requested pins; no annotation or saving yet

commands.name: capabilities
commands.summary: This document

commands.name: version
commands.summary: Noeul's version and the contract, schema and IPC versions it speaks

commands.name: status
commands.summary: Whether Noeul runs, its pins, global hotkey registrations, desktop state and settings; starts nothing

commands.name: health
commands.summary: Checks that the running instance is Noeul of this user and answers; exit 0 only when healthy

commands.name: config.show
commands.summary: Effective settings and the stable per-user paths; reads files only

commands.name: start
commands.summary: Start the resident instance detached (or hand over to the running one); it shows the optional tray icon and registers its global hotkeys

commands.name: run
commands.summary: Run the instance in this process until it quits (what start launches)

commands.name: quit
commands.summary: End the instance: release its hotkeys and close its pins (open pins need --yes)

commands.name: capture
commands.summary: The running instance captures a region of the unlocked interactive desktop and pins it, opens the region selection overlay as F1 does (--interactive, a visible window), or cancels it (--cancel); desktop_unavailable otherwise; nothing is written to disk

commands.name: pin.list
commands.summary: The open pins (IDs and geometry) and the reopenable one

commands.name: pin.close
commands.summary: Close pins; only the last closed pin can be reopened

commands.name: pin.reopen
commands.summary: Reopen the last closed pin with its ID and position

commands.name: hotkeys.list
commands.summary: Noeul's shortcuts: every action with its keys, scope, source, state and registration

commands.name: hotkeys.show
commands.summary: One shortcut action with its bindings and every conflict that involves it

commands.name: hotkeys.set
commands.summary: Replace an action's bindings; a conflicting change is refused (hotkey_conflict) and nothing is written

commands.name: hotkeys.disable
commands.summary: Disable one shortcut, all of them or one scope

commands.name: hotkeys.enable
commands.summary: Turn all shortcuts or one scope back on

commands.name: hotkeys.reset
commands.summary: Restore an action's default, or discard every change (--all keeps a backup)

commands.name: hotkeys.check
commands.summary: Conflict report for Noeul's shortcuts; --all-tools reads every installed tool's hotkey files (starts nothing)

commands.name: hotkeys.export
commands.summary: Print Noeul's hotkeys.json user layer

commands.name: hotkeys.import
commands.summary: Validate a kim.hotkeys document and replace the user layer (keeps a backup)
